title: Patch 0.11: Server Browser and Economy Response
label: Scheduled patch
summary: The WARDOGS team announced scheduled maintenance for Patch 0.11, focused on finding community servers more easily, addressing cash exploits and improving regional capacity.

changes.description: Matchmaking and player-run servers are split into separate browser views, with text search and more reliable server filtering.
Server IDs persist between matches and restarts; the announced update also includes a temporary 5% end-of-match cash bonus.
The team says several cash exploits were fixed and warns that deliberate abuse can result in cash and XP resets or bans.
Server capacity was increased for the Asian region.

title: Season 1 Changelog: Vehicles, Unlocks and Performance
label: Season 1
summary: The Season 1 launch changelog adjusted helicopter handling, vehicle turrets, selected role unlocks, progression and performance features before Early Access release.

changes.description: Z20 Lakota handling received a balance pass, helicopter input damping now applies to every input device, and vehicle turrets have a maximum operator rotation speed.
155mm, 122mm and flare deployables now use more space in a loadout.
Several Career, Medic, Support and Driver unlock levels were adjusted, including the Sports Parachute, Large Backpack, PP-19 drum magazine, URAL and Humvee with minigun.
The changelog includes frame-generation controls, reduced shadow-cache hitching and fixes for several crash paths.

title: Launch Stability Hotfix #1
label: Hotfix
summary: A launch-day client hotfix targeted join failures, unexpected server kicks and extended login queues while the team monitored server capacity.

changes.description: Players were asked to restart and download the latest client before returning to the login queue.
The update targeted failed joins, unexpected kicks during play and extended queue times.

title: WARDOGS Entered Steam Early Access
label: Early Access
summary: WARDOGS launched in Steam Early Access on September 10, bringing its three-team combined-arms battles, persistent cash economy and player-built loadouts to the public build.

changes.description: WARDOGS became available in Steam Early Access on September 10, 2026.
Each player begins with $10,000 and buys a custom loadout before spawning.

title: Closed Beta 02 Announced
label: Beta history
summary: The second closed beta was announced as a scale test for server browsing, queue behaviour, voice chat and related services ahead of Early Access.

changes.description: The announced test focused on systems that only reveal issues at scale, including server capacity, browsing, voice chat, entitlements and queues.
